title: Omnipod Dash just stopped working
body:
3.4.2.2

Pixel 6a Android 16

The pod worked fine for about 12 hours.  
After it delivered a bolus, a few minutes after, it started beeping.  AAPS showed  that it could not connect to the pod.

Would logs help?
What's the best way for submitting them?

comments.body:
I have saved the logs.  
My question is, is there an email I can send the logs to?

If not, I will have to take time to go through all the content to make sure no password or ID is in it before pasting here.

logs@aaps.app
notify me, you did it

I just emailed the logs.
The email subject is:
Omnipod Dash fail 2026_05_10 Navid

Thanks

> [@Navid200](https://github.com/Navid200) and time to search for?

Sorry, I don't understand what you mean by that.
